states that when a channel is archived while archived channels are NOT viewable, the user is removed from it (and kicked out if it is the current channel); when viewable, the channel is kept and marked deleted
decisions.detail: QUOTE: Archiving a channel | `archiveChannel` ... | Sets `delete_at` locally, so the channel stays in the local DB as archived | Removes the current user from the channel locally; and "If the user is viewing that channel, kicks them out (`Events.CHANNEL_ARCHIVED`), then removes the user from the channel" | WHY: The answer states that with the flag off, archiving removes the user from the channel (and kicks them out if they're viewing it). With the flag on, it keeps the channel with `delete_at` set, which is the "marked deleted" half. || QUOTE: Archiving a channel | `archiveChannel` in `app/actions/remote/channel.ts:1390` | Sets `delete_at` locally, so the channel stays in the local DB as archived | Removes the current user from the channel locally; and "If the user is viewing that channel, kicks them out (`Events.CHANNEL_ARCHIVED`), then removes the user from the channel" | WHY: The answer states that with the flag off (not viewable) the user is removed from the channel and kicked out if viewing it, and with the flag on the channel stays with `delete_at` set (marked deleted). || QUOTE: Archiving a channel | `archiveChannel` in `app/actions/remote/channel.ts:1390` | Sets `delete_at` locally, so the channel stays in the local DB as archived | Removes the current user from the channel locally; and "If the user is viewing that channel, kicks them out (`Events.CHANNEL_ARCHIVED`), then removes the user from the channel" | WHY: The answer states that with the flag off (not viewable) the user is removed and kicked out if viewing the channel, while with the flag on the channel stays with delete_at set (marked deleted).
